title: Soft retry windows and idempotency signals for cross-SDKs
creator: Avery Chen
description: Problem: Existing SDK defaults across Python/TypeScript/Go are too brittle for streaming and bursty networks. Users report duplicate operations during transient failures or long-tail latency when clients aggressively retry streaming requests. Goal: introduce a conservative, predictable 'soft retry window' along with standardized idempotency signal semantics and telemetry hooks so application teams can adopt safer defaults without losing liveness. Scope: 1) Define soft retry window semantics and per-request hints (client-side) for non-fatal retries; 2) Standard idempotency signal contract (header/field name + expected server behavior) for unary and resumable streaming calls; 3) Backoff policy presets (conservative, interactive, bulk) mapped to SDK idioms in Python/TS/Go; 4) Telemetry events and metrics to capture dedupe/collision-rate, retry-attempts-per-id, and successful resumptions; 5) Migration notes and examples for customer-facing docs and changelog.
acceptance_criteria: 1) SDKs expose a single opt-in soft_retry_window (ms) parameter with consistent semantics across Python/TS/Go; 2) Idempotency signal name standardized to X-RI-Idempotency (or body field) and documented server contract for streams and unary calls; 3) New default backoff presets implemented in all three SDKs with identical parameterization and demonstrated in integration tests; 4) Telemetry events emitted for retry, dedupe, resume_success, and dedupe_conflict with schema in Console; 5) Migration guide + sample snippets for each language are published and linked in the PR; 6) No regression in existing unit/integration tests and compatibility shims for users relying on previous behaviors.
implementation_notes: Design decisions: - Soft retry window: a short (default 500ms) window after which idempotency is considered 'stale' client-side for stream-resume attempts. Within the window, SDKs will attempt lightweight resume (resume token + no user-visible duplicate). Beyond the window, SDKs fall back to full request with idempotency key suffix to avoid silent duplication. - Idempotency signal: propose X-RI-Idempotency: <uuid> for unary; for streaming, include initial frame metadata and optional per-chunk sequence numbers. Server contract must accept idempotency keys and provide resume token TTL >= soft window. - Backoff presets: conservative: base=200ms, jitter=0.2x, factor=2, max=5s; interactive: base=100ms, jitter=0.1x, factor=1.5, max=2s; bulk: aggressive but capped: base=500ms, jitter=0.5x, factor=2.5, max=12s. - Telemetry: expose event types retry_attempt, resume_attempt, resume_success, dedupe_detected, dedupe_conflict. Include counters and histograms (retry_count, resume_latency_ms).
testing_plan: 1) Unit tests for backoff math and jitter distribution in each SDK. 2) Integration tests: simulate transient network errors and assert at-most-once for unary requests within soft window and safe fallback beyond window. 3) Streaming harness: inject drop/dup/churn to validate resume token flow and dedupe metrics. 4) End-to-end: run against staging runtime with runtime-1.22 image and confirm telemetry surfaces in Console dashboard (test dashboard link below). 5) Performance: measure median p90 latency impact for interactive preset under 5k QPS synthetic load.
qa_checklist: - ESLint/ruff/linters pass for all client libs; - SDK docs updated and code samples compiled; - Migration guide reviewed by PM and DevRel; - Telemetry events visible in staging Console and mapped in dashboards; - Integration tests added to sdk-integration pipeline and passing; - API compatibility acceptance tests green.
comments: 2026-02-15 Avery Chen: Created ticket after customer incident ID-2026-012 where duplicate chat messages were observed during a 2s network hiccup. Initial design proposed soft retry window to reduce duplicates while preserving resume UX.
2026-02-18 Priya Kulkarni: Reviewed draft. Requested explicit server-side resume token TTL and a fallback suffix scheme for idempotency keys to make duplicates detectable in audit logs.

2026-02-22 Diego Martinez: Implemented TypeScript preset and a local harness to simulate 10% packet loss. Early results show dedupe rate reduced by ~72% within soft window. Pushed prototype to github:soft-retry-ts-proto.

2026-02-26 Marco Alvarez (runtime): Confirmed runtime can return resume tokens with TTL; suggested token TTL default 5s to align with client soft default of 500ms and allow safe retry bursts. Need server change tracked in ENG-50890.

2026-02-28 QA: Found a race in Python SDK where resume token was not attached to resumed connection when request timeout < soft window. Added test and mitigation to ensure timeout floor >= soft window + 50ms.
2026-03-01 Product (Lina Park): Asked for user-facing controls in Console to toggle backoff preset per API key for enterprise customers. Created follow-up PM ticket PM-1184.

2026-03-02 Diego Martinez: Updated PRs for TS and Go. Python PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/2543. Running full CI; blocking item: confirm SDKs emit telemetry events with canonical names and schema (telemetry owner: Rahul Singh).
